sources.entry: MySpeed - Speed test analysis software that shows your internet speed for up to 30 days. (Source Code) MIT Docker/Nodejs

summary.one_liner: MySpeed is a self-hosted speed test analysis tool that records internet speed over a configurable retention period and shows the results as statistics.
summary.what_it_does: MySpeed runs scheduled speed tests and stores the results for a retention period the user configures, from a few days to indefinitely. It generates statistics on speed, ping, and related metrics, with a list view and a statistics view on the homepage. Users can schedule tests using Cron expressions and add multiple test servers to one instance. It supports Ookla, LibreSpeed, and Cloudflare speed test servers. Health checks can send notifications by email, Signal, WhatsApp, or Telegram when errors or downtime occur. The README also says it supports Prometheus and Grafana.
use_cases: monitor ISP speed and ping history
alert on internet downtime or failed tests
export speed metrics to Grafana dashboards
how_to_run: Follow the Linux installation guide linked in the README
Follow the Windows installation guide linked in the README
notable: Configurable result retention, from days to forever
Supports Ookla, LibreSpeed, and Cloudflare test servers
Health-check notifications via email, Signal, WhatsApp, or Telegram
